# Start Here {.unnumbered}

This course website is a reference for students in the Code in the Schools DataTrail course. As you complete the course's portfolio assignments, it is our hope that this will be a useful step-by-step guide to showcasing your work. This course will expand on some of the best practices for online data science professional portfolios.

## Sections by Homework Assignment

For DataTrail students following along with this site as a reference for the Homework Assignments, here are what sections match with your assignments' chronology.

- Homework 1: Section 1, Section 2
- Homework 2: Sections 3 through 5
- Homework 3: Section 6, Sections 7 and 7.1
- Homework 4: Section 7.2
- Homework 5: Section 7.3, Section 6
- Homework 6: Section 7.4
- Homework 7: Section 7.5
- Homework 8: Section 6
- Final Portfolio: Optional: Section 8
